description: Track a cross-chain bridge submitted via bridge_quote — returns DONE / PENDING / FAILED plus the receiving-chain tx once it completes. Pass the source-chain tx hash (and the bridge tool from the quote for a faster lookup).

bridge.description: The bridge tool from bridge_quote (e.g. across, stargate) — optional

txHash.description: Source-chain transaction hash from submitting the bridge tx

name: bridge_status
